## Houston v0.6.12

- Scheduled routines now run reliably at every due time, including the top of the hour.
- Your language choice now stays in place after you restart Houston.
- Browser and mobile back and forward controls now move through Houston without leaving the app.
- Cloud agents can now use connected apps, custom tools, skills, memory, and saved files during on-demand work.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
